description: Manages the various types of documents supported within the system, allowing for categorization and retrieval based on document kind.

endpoints.name: GetAll
endpoints.description: Retrieves a paginated list of document types, optionally filtered by the associated entity and sorted.

entityName.description: The name of the entity to which the document types belong (e.g., 'Project', 'Contract').

pageIndex.description: The 0-based index of the page to retrieve.

pageSize.description: The number of items per page.

orderBy.description: The field name to sort the results by.

ascending.description: Specifies the sort order: true for ascending, false for descending.

example_uses: Get all document types for projects, paginated.
List all available document classifications, sorted by name.
Retrieve the second page of document types, with 20 items per page, for the 'Contract' entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this endpoint when you need to fetch a list of predefined document types, potentially for a specific business entity, and require pagination or sorting capabilities.
